responsibility: Implements the crate’s 128-bit SipHash engine, `SipHasher128`, as the hashing core used by stable hashing in `rustc_data_structures`. This file adapts the standard SipHash design to produce 128-bit results, provides optimized buffered handling for byte slices and primitive integer writes, preserves prefix-free string hashing, and exposes finalization through `finish128` while deliberately rejecting the ordinary 64-bit `Hasher::finish` path.
